strengths: Denominator and lane discipline is exemplary: four separate aided denominators, a control cell (cell-025) that never enters unaided_brand_presence, retrieval-only handling for the B5 cell, and search_policy recorded separately from retrieval_used.

Honest limitation accounting rather than padding — W-001 records 25 unaided cells against the 30–48 default, only 2 of 61 candidates are observed language, and the blocked Trustpilot/Reddit/app-store evidence is stated as the single most important limitation.

Contamination handling is complete and auditable: register with allowed exceptions exc-001/002, generic category vocabulary deliberately excluded from the target-term list with a stated rationale, one hard brand hit caught and rejected, and duplicate pairs split with named protected differences.

Decay is treated as a first-class risk: cell-022 quarantined because its World Cup anchor concluded 2026-07-19, and per-claim-class review-by dates for price, fair-use threshold, coverage counts, device lists and registration rules.

Counterevidence preserved rather than smoothed — homepage 'affordable, flexible coverage' held against the ~1 Mbps/3 GB throttling report, and affiliate-density in source-013 recorded as a bias on competitive_mention_share.

Internal arithmetic is consistent across artifacts: 34 cells / 68 candidates / 61 accepted / 32 selected cells reconcile between panel_report.md §5, prompt_qa.json counts and panel.yaml selected_candidate_ids.
judge.summary: A disciplined, evidence-bound panel that is safe to track as a provisional instrument. All fourteen artifacts exist, parse and reconcile numerically (34 cells, 68 candidates, 61 accepted, 32 selected), and panel_report.md §4 exposes every exact prompt string with the dimensions needed to run it. Evidence goes well beyond the target site with correctly classified company/independent/buyer-behaviour/search-proxy sources, no grade-A inflation, calibrated grades for title-only sources, retained conflicts (homepage 'affordable, flexible coverage' vs the ~1 Mbps/3 GB fair-use report) and an unusually honest account of blocked review platforms. Domain boundaries are respected: destination, device support, carrier lock, device origin, validity, data-only, single-device and top-up are all material constraints; local/regional/global are kept distinct with global explicitly partial under W-007; no price is embedded in any prompt and mutable facts carry review-by dates. Contamination and measurement design are the strongest dimensions — one target-brand leak caught and rejected, B0 quarantined into the aided partition, four separate aided denominators, an off-category control, fresh-session and retrieval-state separation, two independent weight systems with an honest equal-weight convention, and provisional/non-representative/non-causal framing throughout. Weaknesses are real but repairable: installation and activation timing is not a distinct job or cell despite direct source support (mh-02 partial); the two 'observed_language' candidates trace to a secondary characterisation of Reddit rather than first-party buyer writing; no sensitivity variant survived QA; unaided breadth is 25 cells against the 30–48 default (waived); all hashes are null; and two small cross-artifact inconsistencies (prompt-001a evidence IDs, charter vs panel locale lists) need cleanup. Mean 4.25, no hard-gate failure, no triggered anti-pattern.
